# Relativistic Jets

Matter leaves the core with bulk Lorentz factor $\Gamma = (1-\beta^2)^{-1/2}$ and slows as it sweeps up mass. ^intro-block

A jet that costs $5 to model and $10 to simulate is still cheaper than a telescope. %%private aside: check the grant budget%%

$$
\frac{d\Gamma}{dr} \propto -\frac{\rho}{\Gamma}
$$
